Wall graphics & wall wraps

Brighten up your spaces with wall wraps

Get a quoteCall 01603 407786

A printed wall wrap is a large vinyl graphic or decal that is printed with digital images or designs and then applied directly to walls or surfaces. Wall wraps can transform the appearance of a room, building exterior, office, or retail space, providing a significant visual impact. They're used for decoration, branding, advertising, and wayfinding purposes, both indoors and outdoors.

Here are a few key points about printed wall wraps:

Types of Wall Wraps

Indoor Wall: Used to decorate interior spaces, enhance brand identity, or convey messages within offices, stores, restaurants, and homes.

Outdoor Wall: Designed to withstand weather elements, used for exterior branding, advertising, and beautifying buildings or spaces.

Temporary Wall: Ideal for events, promotions, or seasonal advertising, these are easier to remove and often made with less permanent adhesive.

Permanent Wall: Made with durable materials and adhesives intended for long-term use, perfect for branding or long-standing decoration.

Materials

Vinyl: The most common material, known for its durability and versatility. There are various types of vinyl, including options suitable for textured surfaces.

Fabric: Some wall wraps are printed on fabric for a different texture and aesthetic. Fabric wraps are often used indoors.

Specialty Materials: Reflective, metallic, or glow-in-the-dark vinyls are used for specific effects or functionalities.

Design and Printing

Custom Designs: Wall wraps can be customized with virtually any design, including photographic images, illustrations, text, and complex graphics.

Digital Printing: High-quality digital printers are used to produce vivid colors and detailed images on the wrap material.

Application

Surface Preparation: The surface must be clean, dry, and smooth for the best adhesion.

Professional Installation: Installing large wall wraps usually requires skilled professionals to ensure it's done correctly without bubbles or wrinkles.

  • Durability: With proper installation and care, wall wraps can last for years. Their lifespan depends on factors like material quality, environmental conditions, and whether they're placed indoors or outdoors.

Benefits

Visual Appeal: They dramatically change the look of a space or building.

Branding and Marketing: Effective for reinforcing brand identity and messaging.

Versatility: Can be applied to various surfaces, including drywall, brick, and concrete.

Cost-Effective: In comparison to traditional painting or wall treatments, wraps offer a durable and impactful alternative.

Using only the best materials from 3M and Metamark, you can rest assured your graphics will last for years.

Whether for commercial use to enhance brand presence or to personalize a residential space, printed wall wraps offer a creative and impactful solution to transform any space.
